title: Keep the Process, Change the Supplier: Runtime Governance for Tool-Using AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.26966v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using AI agents propose actions whose authorization and external effects cannot be inferred from generated text alone. We study an execution boundary that separates agent proposals from business-controlled authority, context disclosure, and supplier selection. The Open Process Control Plane (OPCP) mediates capability calls and records uncertain outcomes when a supplier may have acted without returning an acceptable reply. We evaluate this runtime with scripted requests and synthetic suppliers: 2,400 fault episodes across four policies, 60 process-termination/restart episodes, 19,000 timed calls across 19 configurations, five targeted mutations over 43 fixtures, and 160 substitution records. No language model or autonomous agent is evaluated. OPCP and a conservative composition agree on all measured fault outcomes. translated_title: 保留流程，更换供应商：面向使用工具的AI智能体的运行时治理
translated_abstract: 使用工具的AI智能体会提出各种动作，而这些动作的授权和外部影响无法仅从生成的文本中推断出来。我们研究了一种执行边界，该边界将智能体的动作提议与业务控制的授权、上下文披露以及供应商选择分离开来。开放流程控制平面（OPCP）负责调解能力调用，并在供应商可能已执行操作但未返回可接受回复的情况下记录不确定的结果。我们使用脚本化请求和合成供应商对该运行时进行了评估：涵盖四种策略的2,400个故障事件、60个流程终止/重启事件、跨19种配置的19,000次定时调用、在43个测试装置上进行的五次定向变异，以及160条替换记录。评估中未涉及任何语言模型或自主智能体。OPCP与保守组合策略在所有测量的故障结果上保持一致。两者在收到明确拒绝后均能恢复，且不会产生跨供应商的重复执行；而“重试所有供应商”策略在每种测试的丢失场景中都会导致重复效应。
tldr: 提出开放流程控制平面（OPCP）作为执行边界，将工具型AI智能体的动作提议与业务授权、上下文披露和供应商选择分离，实现运行时治理并在故障恢复时避免跨供应商的重复执行。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Open Process Control Plane (OPCP), an execution boundary that separates tool-using AI agents' action proposals from business-controlled authority, context disclosure, and supplier selection, enabling runtime governance that prevents cross-supplier duplication of effects during recovery.
